testName: Strict Atomic Stock Decrement & Concurrency Benchmark
method: Simultaneous Promise.all execution of 15 createOrder operations
mechanism: MongoDB findOneAndUpdate with condition { 'sizes.label': item.size, 'sizes.stock': { $gte: item.qty } } and atomic decrement { $inc: { 'sizes.$.stock': -item.qty } } followed by compensation rollback on multi-item failure
